_note: Risk limits, network/asset configuration and merchant settlement wallets. This file contains no API keys, private keys, or other secrets — see fintech/payment_config.example.json for the env-var-based secret layout used at runtime.

default_mandate._blocked_categories_note: Enforced directly by the policy engine (category_not_blocked check in pg/policy_engine.py) — belt-and-suspenders on top of allowed_categories being an allow-list, so a category present on both lists is still refused.
default_mandate._allowed_merchants_note: cheapdealsstore is deliberately NOT in this list: it remains searchable/listed in the merchant registry (data/merchant_registry.json), but any purchase routed to it is refused by the merchant_allowed check.

merchant_wallets._note: dev_wallet values are throwaway testnet placeholders already used by merchants/server.py and pg/policy_engine.py for local runs — they hold no real funds. production_wallet is the actual settlement address and must be supplied by FINTECH before any mainnet run.
